name: udixio-ui-governance
description: Audit, synchronize, and create Udixio UI components across React, Angular, core behavior, accessibility, and documentation.

interface.shortDescription: Govern React and Angular components without drift.
interface.longDescription: Audits component quality, accessibility, shared contracts, React-Angular parity, tests, and documentation. It can repair findings, synchronize Angular from the React source, and create complete Material 3 components.
defaultPrompt: Audit Button end to end and fix every verified issue.
Synchronize the Angular component from its React source.
Create a Material 3 component for React and Angular.
